finding.change: The description loses its trailing annotation "[Compiler's note: provision suspended. See 90 Fed. Reg. 50729.]". No rate field changes: general, special and other are byte-identical.
finding.risk: inline_provision_status() in src/parse_note_rules.R derives 'suspended' from exactly this annotation, so a reader that trusts the printed line would see the status fall away and could treat the duty as reactivated.

basis.operative_instruments: The suspension of heading 9903.01.63 is sourced from the executive-order chain, not from the HTS annotation. src/ieepa_reciprocal_initial.py requires the originating order to state that the heading 'and subdivision ... [is] hereby suspended', and src/ieepa_reciprocal_later.py requires each continuation to state that it 'shall continue to be suspended until' a named instant, checking the predecessor order and chronology of every link.
basis.usitc_change_record: The Revision 22 change record lists one item, U.S. note 51(b)(3) of subchapter III chapter 99, modified October 30 by Proclamation 11076. It attests no change to heading 9903.01.63. Change records exclude endnotes and minor nonsubstantive format adjustments, which is what the removed compiler's note is.
basis.collection_ending: IEEPA reciprocal consumption-entry collection ended 2026-02-24T00:00:00-05:00 for EO 14257 and all amendments (FR-2026-03832, CBP CSMS 67834313). compile_reciprocal() emits an explicit coverage record of determination 'no_applicable_rules', status 'verified', for the whole period after that instant. Sections 232 and 301 remain independent of it.
basis.existing_guard: src/ieepa_reciprocal_rules.py asserts china_suspension_until >= collection_ended_at. It holds with eight months of margin (2026-11-10 against 2026-02-24). Note that this guard is against the collection ending, not against build_contract.json's audit_until.

conclusion: The suspension runs to 2026-11-10T00:01:00-05:00, past the audited horizon of 2026-11-03T00:00:00-05:00. Heading 9903.01.63 is therefore suspended throughout the audited window, including at Revision 22's effective instant. Removing the annotation changes the printed description only; it neither establishes nor accompanies a reactivation, and no unresolved_source is required.
forward_requirement: The continuation chain ends at 2026-11-10T00:01:00-05:00, seven days past the current horizon. If a later instrument extends the suspension it should be added to the configured suspension documents so the chain stays reconciled. A lapse would be a legal event worth recording, but it would not by itself resume a reciprocal charge on consumption entries: collection for EO 14257 and all amendments ended 2026-02-24, and the compiler already emits 'no_applicable_rules' for every interval after that instant. The suspension and the collection ending are independent legal events, so neither terminates the other; the practical effect of a lapse would only reach entries that some later instrument brought back into collection.
corrected: An earlier draft of this artifact said a lapse would mean 'the reciprocal China rate resumes'. That overstated it: it was written before the collection ending was checked.
